verdict.rationale: Productboard's own API documents associating feedback with users and companies, with dedicated endpoints to create, list, and delete those relationships, and its feedback records carry customer attribution. That directly delivers linking feedback to the customers who submitted it. missing for 10: documentation of the in-app UI flow a product manager would use to attribute feedback to a customer, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link individual feedback items to the specific customers who submitted them

citations.quote: Associate feedback with users and companies, and connect it to features, components, and other product hierarchy entities. Dedicated endpoints create, list, and delete these relationships.
Create, read, update, delete, and search customer feedback, complete with text content, tags, owners, source metadata, and customer attribution.
